A social media post claimed responsibility for the attack and linked the perpetrators to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. Police are investigating all angles, including potential links to a similar threat in Ashok Nagar district.

recent_articles.title: How Maharashtra Legislature cleared the Freedom of Religion Bill, and why most of the opposition parties did not oppose it - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Maharashtra** legislature passed the Freedom of Religion Bill, making it the 13th state in India to have such legislation.  While the bill was supported by opposition parties like the Shiv Sena UBT and NCP SP, concerns were raised about its potential infringement on religious freedom and lack of empirical data to justify its need. The bill aims to crack down on forced conversions but has faced criticism from Congress MLA Aslam Sheikh who called it regressive and a one-sided target against a particular community.  **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, however, argued that the current legal framework was insufficient to handle the law and order situation caused by such cases.

recent_articles.title: In politics, there's no full stop: PM bids farewell to 59 Rajya Sabha members; hails Deve Gowda, Kharge, Sharad Pawar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** addressed the Rajya Sabha on Wednesday, March 18, 2026, as 59 members retired between April and July. **Modi** praised outgoing legislators for their contributions to national life and urged them to continue engaging with society. He highlighted the importance of bipartisan collaboration in Parliament and commended senior leaders like **H.D. Deve Gowda**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **Sharad Pawar** for their dedication to parliamentary proceedings.  **Modi** also recognized outgoing Deputy Chairman **Harivansh** for his commitment to engaging with youth on national issues, while acknowledging the departure of Union Minister **Ramdas Athawale**.

recent_articles.title: Sharavathi Hydroelectric Project: The cost of energy transition - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Karnataka High Court** has ordered a halt to work on the Sharavathi Pumped Storage Hydroelectric Project until further orders, following a challenge from environmentalists. The project, proposed in the Sharavathi Lion-Tailed Macaque Wildlife Sanctuary, faces opposition from various groups concerned about its impact on forests and endangered species.  The **Karnataka Power Corporation Limited (KPCL)** aims to generate 2,000 MW of power through the project but has been criticized for its cost escalation and lack of environmental clearances. The project's future remains uncertain as it faces legal setbacks and expert reports highlighting potential ecological damage.

recent_articles.title: Centre and State government have failed to manage LPG shortage: NCP-SP leader Jayant Patil - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)-SP** accused the **BJP-led Mahayuti government** of failing to manage the LPG gas shortage and blaming the opposition for the crisis.  **Jayant Patil**, an NCP-SP senior leader, stated that the government has refused to share information on the situation and take citizens and opposition into confidence. **Devendra Fadnavis**, the Chief Minister, previously accused the opposition, including **Rahul Gandhi**, of creating panic about the shortage, while **Chhagan Bhujbal**, the Food and Civil Supplies Minister, claimed authorities seized 1,208 LPG cylinders during a crackdown on stockpiling.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly Elections 2026: NCP(SP) announces candidates, Saseendran to be fielded again in Elathur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP(SP))** announced its candidates for the upcoming Kerala Assembly elections.  **A.K. Saseendran**, Minister for Forest and Wildlife, will be contesting from Elathur, while **Thomas K. Thomas** will represent Kuttanad and **K.T. Mujeeb** Malappuram. recent_articles.title: NCP (SP) not to contest Baramati seat against Sunetra, says Sule - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) has decided not to contest the Baramati Assembly by-election against NCP leader and Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar.  **Supriya Sule**, working president of the party, stated that the allies of **Maha Vikas Aghadi (MVA)** will discuss the Rahuri seat's candidacy. Bypolls for both seats are scheduled for April 23rd.

recent_articles.title: Consensus reached to revoke suspension of eight Opposition MPs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Speaker Om Birla** convened a meeting with floor leaders from both the **government** and **Opposition**, leading to a consensus on revoking the suspensions of eight Opposition MPs. The agreement includes restrictions on disruptive behavior, such as crossing into the Well of the House or protesting at the desk of the secretary general.  The decision comes after seven Congress MPs and one CPI(M) MP were suspended for unruly behavior during the first part of the Budget session.

recent_articles.title: Thoothukudi schoolgirl’s murder: HC directs Vilathikulam DSP to take up probe - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court** ordered a **Vilathikulam Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP)** to investigate the murder of a 17-year-old girl in Thoothukudi. The court directed the DSP to record statements from the girl's parents and requested their cooperation with the investigation.  The State government suspended two police officials for delaying the FIR registration and initiated departmental proceedings against them. A postmortem was conducted, DNA samples were sent for analysis

recent_articles.title: As Rahul Gandhi eyes Dalit consolidation through Kanshi Ram in U.P., BSP gets unsettled, political slugfest intensified - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
**Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Lok Sabha**'s Opposition, is aiming to mobilize Dalits in Uttar Pradesh for the **Congress party**. He seeks to strengthen the party’s social justice narrative by demanding the **Bharat Ratna** for **Kanshi Ram**, founder of the **Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP)**. This move has unsettled the BSP and its leader **Mayawati**, while the **Congress party in U.P.** is enthusiastic about Gandhi's efforts, hoping to consolidate Dalit support in favor of the Congress ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.

Gandhi’s outreach towards Dalits has been evident in recent days.  He addressed a ‘Samvidhan Sammelan’ program on March 13th organized by the state **Congress** in Lucknow, marking Kanshi Ram’s birth anniversary. He claimed that if his great-grandfather, India's first Prime Minister **Jawaharlal Nehru**, were alive at the time of Kanshi Ram's rise, he would have been made Chief Minister from the **Congress**.  He acknowledged past shortcomings by the **Congress** in fulfilling its responsibilities, which led to leaders like **Kanshi Ram** charting their own political path. 

On Kanshi Ram’s birth anniversary on Sunday (March 15, 2026), Gandhi wrote to **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** demanding the highest civilian honor for him. The outreach is a renewed effort to engage with Dalits, a large social group comprising roughly 21% of the total electorate in U.P., positioning the **Congress** as staunch advocates for issues faced by marginalized communities.  The **BSP**, founded by **Kanshi Ram**, has accused the **Congress** of constantly trying to weaken it through various tactics. The **Samajwadi Party (SP)**, while not directly reacting to Gandhi's attempts, signals that all demands are already raised by the U.P.-centric party. Analysts point out that bold assertions by **Gandhi** need to translate into action on the ground to shift a sizeable Dalit support in favor of the **Congress**.

## Sand Smuggling Crackdown in Chittoor: Two Lorries Seized, Driver Arrested

Chittoor district police have stepped up their efforts to combat illegal sand mining and smuggling.  On Saturday night, during routine vehicle checks on the Vellore road, a special team apprehended a driver attempting to transport illegally mined sand. The team, led by Additional SP S.R. Rajasekhar Raju, discovered two sand-laden lorries at the Naraharipeta checkpost. One driver fled the scene upon being signaled to stop, while the other was apprehended and identified as Shanmugam from Chittoor.  Shanmugam confessed to transporting the illegally mined sand from the Neeva riverbed in Puthalapattu towards various locations in Tamil Nadu, including Chennai, Salem, and Vellore. Police have registered a case and are currently investigating the matter.
